gauge.name: Rocky  Branch (SC) at Whaley Street

impacts.statement: Water floods the intersection of Whaley and Main Streets to a depth of 4 feet.
Water floods the intersection of Whaley and Main Street with approximately 6 inches of water covering the road.
Flood stage, water gets out of Rocky Branch Creek channel.
